name: tabs
blurb: Animated tabs with smooth content crossfade and sliding underline.
description: Controlled tab component that animates the active tab indicator with Framer Motion spring physics. Renders tab buttons and animated content pane with fade-in effects. Includes FadeInDiv helper for content transitions.
use_when: Tab interfaces where smooth content transitions and spring-based animations enhance perceived polish. Good for feature showcases or settings panels.
avoid_when: Accessibility-critical interfaces; keyboard navigation not fully supported. Heavy animations may impact performance on slower devices.
a11y: No built-in keyboard support or ARIA attributes. Focus management must be implemented by parent.

props.name: tabs
props.type: Array<{value: string; label: string; content: React.ReactNode}>
